prior_adoption_scope: 609 no code adopted. 610 narrow human-gate fragment adopted in113 software; owner diagnostics/Native separate.
generic_lessons: A diagnostic that truncates a verified persistent Prepare reply before the city command can establish durable old-arm no replay, but never proves recovery after an already-issued command of unknown outcome.

Keep a separate original pre-failure save. A no-replay cold case that remains hungry and a normal rescue on the original empty-journal save are different outcomes; loading the latter is not manual journal clearing.

Count actual original Runner invocations with a transparent owned wrapper, then restore exact bindings. Log markers, persistent full record, actual purchased city, food, and same-world turn readiness are separate evidence.

An official successful Load ACK, a loading-screen Continue and a qualified endpoint are distinct. During an in-process reload LSQ may time out on a still-owned listener; wait for the original screen, requalify and never replay the Load to fix diagnostics.
A cold exact binary-install check is not sufficient for native realm ports; read actual nil/true methods and the now-working protected bridge.

A naturally raised completed-event popup after ordinary progression qualifies a different route than diagnostic use of the original Show callback. Preserve the original physical confirmation and separate its unknown native mark-seen count.
scope_limit: Frozen 113 pre-send fault + normal food and UI narrow window. No issued-native-command unknown recovery, whole matrix, completed-save reload or publication at cutoff.
